assumptions: Homogeneous plasma with a preferred time-like four-vector u^mu.
CP-even and parity-even background; no chiral chemical potential.
Electroweak-symmetric phase and exact color/weak covariance.
Angular anisotropy is carried by spherical-harmonic dependence of form factors, not by adding a fixed anisotropy vector.

objects.constraints: Background gauge condition and STI monitor; physical self-energy transverse subspace has two dressings in equilibrium.
objects.note: The fourth mixed structure is retained as a truncation/gauge diagnostic.

objects.constraints: Chiral projector removes the scalar term for Q_L; vectorlike D retains it.
objects.note: Additional CP-odd structures are excluded by the declared state symmetry.

objects.basis: Three Q-transverse Lorentz vectors tensor the complete 16-element Dirac/Clifford basis.
objects.constraints: Longitudinal 16-component matrix fixed by STI; transverse 48-component subspace evolved.
objects.note: This replaces the four-tensor seed used only for v1.8 initialization.

objects.basis: One Q-parallel direction plus a numerical three-vector basis of null(q_lower).
objects.constraints: Longitudinal component fixed by Ward/ST identity.
objects.note: Complete for a Lorentz vector at generic non-null Q.

objects.basis: Complete Clifford basis projected as P_R Gamma_A P_L for one orientation; conjugate basis for h.c.
objects.note: Four complex components per chiral orientation at generic kinematics.

objects.basis: Complete Dirac/Clifford basis; chiral projection where applicable.
objects.constraints: Color/group tensor factored; matrix form factors are evolved or reconstructed.
objects.note: This removes the v1.8 common-scalar-kernel limitation.

objects.basis: Tensor product of three independent transverse Lorentz bases, one for each external momentum.
objects.constraints: Longitudinal/STI completion plus Bose/color permutation constraints.
objects.note: The 27 fully transverse amplitudes are evolved; permutation symmetry is enforced as a linear projector.

objects.constraints: Kernel K=delta Sigma_H/delta G_H from the identical truncation.
